title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
description: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
description: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.

title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
description: Massachusetts has become the third state in as many months to slap new restrictions on data center development.

title: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
description: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.

title: Everything Apple announced at its fall iPhone event, from the foldable iPhone Duo to an always-listening Apple Watch
description: The main event was the tech giant's highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

title: The hinge for Apple’s new foldable phone was built with AI
description: Apple says it used AI and 3D printing in the manufacturing process for its long-awaited foldable phone.

title: Apple’s revamped Health app will calculate your ‘health age’ and readiness score
description: The update uses Apple Intelligence to make better sense of your health data.

title: Apple has a new way to prove your iPhone photos aren’t AI slop
description: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users determine whether photos have been edited, including alterations made by AI.

title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
description: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.

title: Superintelligence is coming. Should we let it?
description: AI companies have been talking about superintelligent AI like it’s inevitable, but recent safety incidents like OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach are demonstrating the potential dangers of deploying AI systems that are more capable than humans. So what happens when we can’t reliably control what these systems do? On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan is joined by Connor Leahy, an AI researcher, entrepreneur, and now the U.S. Executive Director of […]

title: Viral AI assistant Instinct now has its own email address
description: Instinct’s new email feature lets the AI agent create and manage accounts, contact businesses, handle support requests, and do more on users' behalf.

title: ‘Gambling with our lives’: Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
description: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned over AI extinction fears, calling for pacing agreements between labs.

title: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
description: Users can ask the assistant to do things like "Create a cart for my Saturday tailgate for 25 people and include some brunch items," or "Build a cart for easy school lunches and after-school snacks," Shipt says.

title: AI spend per employee slumped at top firms in August — summer doldrums or a warning sign?
description: Falling token costs, cheaper models, and less spend per employee — AI adoption isn't playing out the way hyperscalers hoped.

title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks
description: Cymphony gives security teams a single view of employees, AI agents, and other nonhuman identities, including the systems and sensitive data they can access.

title: Instacart launches an AI grocery shopping assistant called Clementine
description: Instacart is the latest app to bake a conversational AI assistant into its platform.

title: Besxar is building an orbital semiconductor factory, one SpaceX rocket at a time
description: Besxar, a startup founded by former OpenAI staffer Ashley Pilipiszyn, wants to make the key precursors for advanced semiconductors by taking advantage of the vacuum of space.

title: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
description: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model.
